stem:
Inder studies four Class 7 topics in one week: how soap cleans oily hands, how exercise changes breathing, how a shadow grows longer near sunset, and why day and night follow each other.

Which conclusion about these topics is best?

options.text: They belong to different fields, yet they are connected ways of studying the same world.
Only the breathing topic is real science; shadows and day–night sit outside science.
Each topic sits in a sealed subject box, so materials ideas cannot help with light or the body.
He should treat them as four unrelated word lists for separate tests.

teacher.key_rationale: Science fields differ but stay connected ways of studying one world.
